title: Buffalo man faces 25 years for robbery of Hamburg liquor store - NewsBreak
text:
By Kayleigh Hunter-Gasperini ,
10 hours ago
BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) ‚Äî A Buffalo man could be sentenced to a maximum of 25 years in prison for a robbery of a liquor store in Hamburg back in 2022, the Erie County District Attorney‚Äôs Office announced.
Around 7:50 p.m. on Nov. 22, Jayshawn Williams, 35, and a co-defendant forcibly stole property from a liquor store on Lakeshore Road. They were both wearing ski masks at the time of the crime, officials said.
An apparent handgun was used in the robbery. Williams and his co-defendant allegedly stole cash, several bottles of liquor and a victim‚Äôs cellphone.
Hamburg police initiated a traffic stop of the suspect vehicle and a female driver surrendered. Williams moved to the driver‚Äôs seat and drove away, fleeing into Lackawanna.
Williams and co-defendant Mark Rockmore, 31, of Buffalo, were apprehended near Madison Street. Several bottles of Hennessey, ski masks and $853 were recovered.
Rockmore pleaded guilty to second-degree robbery in June 2025 and is currently serving a determinate sentence of seven years in prison as a second violent felony offender.
Williams faces a maximum of 25 years in prison as a second violent felony offender. He was found guilty of first-degree robbery.
He remains held without bail and is expected to be sentenced March 25.
